sections.title: International Relations Expert Akmaral Batalova
paragraphs: "The objectives of the Organization of Turkic States, Russia and China are not at odds"

Akmaral Batalova is an expert on international relations, reporter and film producer. She is also the founder and Executive Director of the Al Farabi World Heritage Public Foundation. She was born in Almaty, Kazakhstan, graduated from the Mass Media Faculty of Kazakh State University, the Diplomatic Academy of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Diplomatic School of Madrid and has a Master’s degree in International Relations from the Complutense University (Spain). Akmaral Batalova observes the situation in the Middle East, focusing on the humanitarian crisis in Syria, writes articles and makes documentaries and does humanitarian work in Syria

How to cite: Batalova, A. (2023). The objectives of the Organization of Turkic States, Russia, and China are not at odds. (Ali Erdem Köz, Interviewer). BRIQ Belt & Road Initiative Quarterly, 4(3), 62-67.
